name: Washer Solve

features.text: Quickly dissolves dirt, grime, road film and bug-matter.
One bottle can be diluted to fill most windshield washer reservoirs.

description: SPECIALLY FORMULATED TO: (1) quickly dissolve dirt, grime, road film, and bug-matter; and (2) leave the windshield bright and shiny-clean without any streaks. It is designed not harm the paint, metal or rubber surfaces of a vehicle. Not intended for applications in which freeze-resistant is required.
application: Premix 2 oz. (one bottle) of concentrate per one (1) gallon of water (preferably filtered or deionized) and then add to the reservoir.
